Unduh chart.umd.min.js dan letakkan di folder ini sebelum demo.

Perintah:
  curl -Lo chart.umd.min.js https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.3/dist/chart.umd.min.js

Atau di VPS:
  cd ~/smart-kitchen-backend/dashboard/assets/vendor
  curl -Lo chart.umd.min.js https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.3/dist/chart.umd.min.js
